sample.text: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

sample.text: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

sample.title: CVE-2026-134791: Since Symfony 7.2, expressions can contain comments. The lexer used a regular expression t
sample.text: Since Symfony 7.2, expressions can contain comments. The lexer used a regular expression to find the end of a comment. When a /* was never closed, this regular expression scanned the rest of the expression, and the lexer then went on with the next character. So each /* scanned the rest of the expression again. Linting 192 KB of /* took 9 to 11 seconds, and 96 KB took 34 seconds without PCRE JIT. The lexer runs before the parser and its nesting limit. Any code that lints or parses untrusted expressions is affected, including the ExpressionSyntax validation constraint. A Length constraint on the same value doesn't help, since the validator runs both constraints. The lexer now uses strpos() to find the end of a comment, and a comment that is never closed throws a SyntaxError. Such expressions were already invalid. Lexing takes linear time again.
sample.summary: تحديث Symfony 7.2 يعالج ثغرة في معالجة التعليقات داخل التعبيرات، حيث كان المُحلل يُستخدم تعبيرًا منطقيًا لتحديد نهاية التعليق، مما أدى إلى تأخير في معالجة التعبيرات غير المغلقة. الآن يتم استخدام دالة strpos() لتحديد نهاية التعليق، مما يمنع استغلال المهاجمين عبر التعليقات غير المغلقة.

sample.title: CVE-2026-136184: compose-farm 0.19.0 before 1.22.0 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking and cross-site
sample.text: compose-farm 0.19.0 before 1.22.0 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking and cross-site request forgery vulnerability because its unauthenticated web UI performs no Origin validation. Malicious websites visited by users can open /ws/shell/{host} or /ws/exec sockets, or abuse unquoted service parameters and PUT /api/console/file, to execute commands on all managed hosts.
sample.summary: تحتوي إصدارات compose-farm 0.19.0 قبل 1.22.0 على ثغرة تسمح للمهاجم بالاستيلاء على الاتصالات WebSocket عبر مواقع خارجية دون مصادقة.

sample.text: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by a Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) vulnerability.
